environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a classic ELB configured in TCP passthrough mode on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask application runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers, bound to 0.0.0.0:8080. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured. The ELB performs TLS termination but does not inspect HTTP content. Instance IAM role has only S3 read access for config files.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough mode, no HTTP-level inspection
